    • Director(s): Girish A. D.

    Summary: A breezy, heartwarming romantic comedy following Justin Davis, an audio cassette enthusiast known as 'Mp3 King', and Ashley Thankachan, exploring love, family dynamics, and endearing relationships. Source:IMDB

    Plot

    Justin Davis (Nivin Pauly), an energetic audio enthusiast famously dubbed 'Mp3 King' in his local neighborhood, crosses paths with Ashley Thankachan (Mamitha Baiju). Amidst eccentric family units, lively cousins, and hilarious misadventures involving brothers Joel and friends Glixon and Baiju, a tender, unconventional romance blooms that tests familial bonds and modern relationships in the most hilarious and heartwarming fashion. Source:IMDB
